# Candor

> Flat-fee B Corp and sustainability certification consulting for small businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

Candor is a one-person consultancy run by Artem Furman. It helps BC small businesses achieve B Corp certification and related sustainability credentials. Every engagement runs directly through Artem — no junior staff, no subcontractors.

## Services

- Readiness Audit ($1,800 CAD, 2 weeks): Gap analysis against B Corp standards. Delivered as a written report. Client keeps the report regardless of whether they continue.
- Gap-Closing ($6,500 CAD, 3-4 months): Documentation, policy drafts, tracking systems, evidence compilation.
- Full Path ($12,000+ CAD, 9-12 months): Complete certification support from first call to certified B Corp status.

## Industries served

Cannabis retail, outdoor and apparel, food and beverage, clean beauty, coffee and hospitality, yoga and fitness studios.

## Certifications covered

- B Corp (primary): Rigorous third-party verified certification across governance, workers, community, environment, and customers. Minimum score of 80 required. Annual fee ~$2,100 USD for companies under $5M revenue.
- Climate Neutral: Carbon footprint measurement, reduction, and offset. Annual renewal.
- 1% for the Planet: 1% of annual revenue donated to environmental nonprofits.
